Source: https://www.libsdl.org/projects/SDL_mixer/release/SDL_mixer-1.2.12.tar.gz (timidity directory). Original copyright and Artistic license retained in source and COPYING. Local modifications rename LoadSong_RW implementation and add compatibility wrappers for the SDK mixer, whose public RW API has no freesrc argument. The build renames Init/PlaySome through compiler flags for MidiPcm.cpp.
